# Reference

Every concept of the approach, its type and definition, and the checks that hold it, generated from [ontology.md](../ontology.md) and [checks.md](../checks.md). Automatic checks are enforced by the tool; manual checks are what a reviewer does, because the tool cannot. The pages of this directory explain the parts; this page is what they refer to.

| Kind      | Term                    | ID                             | Type                                                                                  | Definition                                                                                                                        |

| Field     | Type                    | `field.concept.type`           | text optional                                                                         | For fields and relations only: a type from the neutral vocabulary.                                                                |
| Field     | Definition              | `field.concept.definition`     | text                                                                                  | What the concept is, in one or two sentences. Tooltips, reference pages and contracts quote it.                                   |

| Rule      | Kind order              | `rule.kind-order`              |                                                                                       | Rows are grouped by kind in the configured order: entity, field, relation, derived, concept, rule, invariant, hook, action, view. |

| Rule      | Definitions say what    | `rule.definition-says-what`    |                                                                                       | A definition is short and says what the thing is, not how it is built.                                                            |
| Rule      | Concept with its entity | `rule.concept-with-its-entity` |                                                                                       | A concept that involves several entities sits with the entity it constrains or changes.                                           |
| Invariant | One definition row      | `inv.one-definition-row`       |                                                                                       | Every ID has exactly one definition row, in one table.                                                                            |
| Invariant | Known classes           | `inv.known-classes`            |                                                                                       | Every ID belongs to a class the configuration lists.                                                                              |
| Invariant | Kind named once         | `inv.kind-named-once`          |                                                                                       | The Kind cell names the kind on the first row of its group and is empty on the rest.                                              |
| Invariant | Field with its entity   | `inv.field-in-its-entity`      |                                                                                       | A field or relation sits in the table of the entity its ID names, and a table holds one entity.                                   |
| Invariant | References defined      | `inv.references-defined`       |                                                                                       | Every ID used anywhere has a definition row; the decision log may also use retired IDs.                                           |

| Invariant | Tried                   | `inv.concept-tried`            |                                                                                       | Every concept has a mockup element, a ticket or an implementation. Reported as information.                                       |
| Invariant | IDs are permanent       | `inv.ids-permanent`            |                                                                                       | Renaming a term changes its row's text, never its ID.                                                                             |

| `check.test.does-what-it-says` | `inv.test-does-what-check-says` | a tagged test                                                            | a reviewer reads it with its check | it sets up GIVEN, does WHEN and asserts THEN | manual |

## Test suite

| Kind      | Term               | ID                         | Type | Definition                                                                               |
| --------- | ------------------ | -------------------------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Test suite         | `ent.test-suite`           |      | A kind of test the team runs, such as unit or end-to-end, and the classes it must prove. |
| Field     | Name               | `field.test-suite.name`    | text | Unique among the suites.                                                                 |
| Field     | Covers             | `field.test-suite.cover`   | text | The classes whose implemented concepts the suite must prove.                             |
| Invariant | Unique names       | `inv.suite-names-unique`   |      | No two suites share a name.                                                              |
| Invariant | Not empty          | `inv.suite-not-empty`      |      | Every suite has test files.                                                              |
| Invariant | Covers its classes | `inv.suite-covers-classes` |      | Every implemented concept of a covered class is proven by a test of the suite.           |

| Check                                | Concepts                   | GIVEN                                                  | WHEN           | THEN                                          | Proof |
| ------------------------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `check.test-suite.uncovered-concept` | `inv.suite-covers-classes` | an implemented invariant has no test in the unit suite | the check runs | it names the concept and the suite, and fails | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.duplicate-name`    | `inv.suite-names-unique`   | two suites are named unit                              | the check runs | it names the suite and fails                  | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.empty`             | `inv.suite-not-empty`      | a suite's directory has no test files                  | the check runs | it names the suite and fails                  | auto  |

## Ticket

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                             | Type                     | Definition                                                                                            |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Ticket                 | `ent.ticket`                   |                          | A slice of the gap: what to build now, within which limits.                                           |
| Field     | Why now                | `field.ticket.why-now`         | text                     | Why this slice comes before the rest of the gap.                                                      |
| Field     | Out of scope           | `field.ticket.out-of-scope`    | text optional            | What not to build, though it is target too.                                                           |
| Field     | Pre-authorized         | `field.ticket.pre-authorized`  | text optional            | Permissions the agent would otherwise stop and ask for.                                               |
| Relation  | Slice                  | `edge.ticket.concepts`         | refs ent.concept         | The concepts to build.                                                                                |
| Relation  | Checks                 | `edge.ticket.checks`           | refs ent.check optional  | The checks of the slice.                                                                              |
| Relation  | Depends on             | `edge.ticket.depends-on`       | refs ent.ticket optional | Slices that must be done first.                                                                       |
| Derived   | Gap                    | `derived.gap`                  |                          | The work left: target concepts with their checks, automatic checks without a test, known divergences. |
| Derived   | Slice done             | `derived.slice-done`           |                          | Every concept of the slice implemented and every automatic check of it tested.                        |
| Rule      | No behavior in tickets | `rule.ticket-without-behavior` |                          | A ticket does not describe behavior; behavior is in the check catalogue, written before the ticket.   |
| Invariant | Names its concepts     | `inv.ticket-has-ids`           |                          | A ticket has an IDs: line.                                                                            |
| Invariant | Related checks         | `inv.ticket-checks-related`    |                          | Every check a ticket lists exists and names one of its concepts.                                      |
| Action    | Cut a slice            | `action.cut-slice`             |                          | Take part of the gap and write the ticket with its limits and permissions.                            |

| Check                          | Concepts                            | GIVEN                                                         | WHEN                         | THEN                                                                            | Proof  |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.ticket.no-ids`          | `inv.ticket-has-ids`                | a ticket has no `IDs:` line                                   | the check runs               | it names the ticket and fails                                                   | auto   |
| `check.ticket.unknown-check`   | `inv.ticket-checks-related`         | a ticket lists a check the catalogue does not have            | the check runs               | it names the ticket and the check, and fails                                    | auto   |
| `check.ticket.unrelated-check` | `inv.ticket-checks-related`         | a ticket lists a check that names none of its concepts        | the check runs               | it names the ticket and the check, and fails                                    | auto   |
| `check.ticket.slice-open`      | `derived.slice-done`, `derived.gap` | a ticket whose concepts are not built                         | `--gap` runs with the ticket | it lists them with their checks, prints `SLICE_OPEN` and exits 1                | auto   |
| `check.ticket.slice-done`      | `derived.slice-done`                | a ticket whose concepts are built and whose checks are tested | `--gap` runs with the ticket | it prints `SLICE_DONE` and exits 0                                              | auto   |
| `check.ticket.no-behavior`     | `rule.ticket-without-behavior`      | a ticket                                                      | a reviewer reads it          | it lists concepts and checks; any behavior it needs is already in the catalogue | manual |

## Agent rules

| Kind   | Term            | ID                                | Type | Definition                                                                                                              |
| ------ | --------------- | --------------------------------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity | Agent rules     | `ent.agent-rules`                 |      | The section of the agents' instructions that says what else to update when something changes, and what to run.          |
| Rule   | Short           | `rule.agent-rules-short`          |      | The section is short enough to be read at the start of every session.                                                   |
| Rule   | Points at files | `rule.agent-rules-point-at-files` |      | Every row names a path or a command.                                                                                    |
| Rule   | Start from IDs  | `rule.start-from-ids`             |      | Every task starts by naming the IDs it touches; a task that cannot is not about meaning, or the ontology is incomplete. |

| Check                                  | Concepts                                                    | GIVEN                   | WHEN                | THEN                                                          | Proof  |
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.agent-rules.short-and-concrete` | `rule.agent-rules-short`, `rule.agent-rules-point-at-files` | the agent rules section | a reviewer reads it | it fits on one screen and every row names a path or a command | manual |
| `check.agent-rules.start-from-ids`     | `rule.start-from-ids`                                       | a task for an agent     | the agent starts    | it names the IDs the task touches before writing code         | manual |

## Contract

| Kind      | Term         | ID                     | Type | Definition                                                                          |
| --------- | ------------ | ---------------------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Contract     | `ent.contract`         |      | A JSON Schema per entity, generated from the types of its fields and relations.     |
| Invariant | Fields typed | `inv.typed-fields`     |      | Every field and relation has a type from the vocabulary, and no other kind has one. |
| Invariant | Current      | `inv.contract-current` |      | The contract equals what the generator writes now.                                  |

| Check                          | Concepts               | GIVEN                                                                                              | WHEN           | THEN                                          | Proof |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `check.contract.untyped-field` | `inv.typed-fields`     | a field row has no type                                                                            | the check runs | it names the field and fails                  | auto  |
| `check.contract.bad-type`      | `inv.typed-fields`     | a field's type is outside the vocabulary, or a reference points at something that is not an entity | the check runs | it names the field and the problem, and fails | auto  |
| `check.contract.stale`         | `inv.contract-current` | the contract was edited by hand, or a type changed without regenerating                            | the check runs | it names the contract file and fails          | auto  |

## Doc section

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                          | Type             | Definition                                                                                              |
| --------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Doc section            | `ent.doc-section`           |                  | A hand-written section of a page for people, anchored to what it explains.                              |
| Field     | Stamp                  | `field.doc-section.stamp`   | text optional    | A short hash of each definition as it was when the section was last reread.                             |
| Relation  | Explains               | `edge.doc-section.explains` | refs ent.concept | The concepts and checks the section explains.                                                           |
| Relation  | In set                 | `edge.doc-section.set`      | ref ent.doc-set  | The doc set the page belongs to.                                                                        |
| Derived   | To reread              | `derived.to-reread`         |                  | A section anchored to a definition that changed after its stamp.                                        |
| Rule      | Every section anchored | `rule.anchor-every-section` |                  | Every section that explains a concept has an anchor; unanchored sections are not checked.               |
| Rule      | Reread, then stamp     | `rule.reread-then-stamp`    |                  | A section listed as anchored to a changed definition is reread, fixed if needed, and only then stamped. |
| Rule      | Readers' words         | `rule.readers-words`        |                  | Pages explain in the readers' words; they do not copy definitions, which reference pages restate.       |
| Invariant | Anchors resolve        | `inv.anchors-resolve`       |                  | Every anchor names IDs of concepts or checks that exist.                                                |

| Check                                   | Concepts                                          | GIVEN                                                           | WHEN                                                                    | THEN                                                                              | Proof  |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.doc-section.not-an-id`           | `inv.anchors-resolve`                             | an anchor says `Place hold` instead of an ID                    | the check runs                                                          | it names the page and the text, and fails                                         | auto   |
| `check.doc-section.reread-after-change` | `derived.to-reread`                               | a definition changed after a section anchored to it was stamped | the check runs, the section is reread and stamped, the check runs again | the first run lists the section as information; the second does not               | auto   |
| `check.doc-section.anchored`            | `rule.anchor-every-section`, `rule.readers-words` | a page of a doc set                                             | a reviewer reads it                                                     | every section that explains a concept has an anchor, and none copies a definition | manual |
| `check.doc-section.reread-before-stamp` | `rule.reread-then-stamp`                          | sections listed to reread                                       | someone stamps them                                                     | they reread each section first and fixed what changed                             | manual |
